text:
kevin: Drafting internal RN + brief for the 23:30 PT microdeploy (runtime v2.4.2). Change window 23:30 PT -> 00:15 PT. TL;DR: batching stall fix, Dedicated scaler cooldown tweak, KV init guard. Need quick thumbs on RN copy, canary cadence, and rollback pin duration.

ops-sam: I'll run the deploy. Proposed canary: 4% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds. Health checks: error-rate <2%, p95 <800ms. Rollback triggers: sustained error >=2% for 5m OR p95 >900ms for 8m OR new P1 pager. Rollback plan: rollback to v2.4.1 + routing pin for 45m.

rachael: Quick RN copy tweak: add Known Impact line: "Some Dedicated customers may observe short reconnects during pool churn; no data loss expected." Also include link to changelog and runbook.

infra-bot: Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy. Oncall list: @oncall-runtime, @infra-ops. Infra suggests pin duration 60m if rollback invoked because KV guard touches routing state.

ops-sam: Noted. I'm fine with 60m pin in emergency. For normal fallback let's pin 45m. I'll queue deploybot once staging smoke is green. Deploy command I'll run:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.4.2 canary=4% step=10m health=svc-metrics-check
```
Manual increments at each hold; abort with `deploybot cancel 1766667000`.

deploybot: deploy queued by ops-sam. Staging smoke: passing. Canary plan loaded. To rollback: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.4.1 --reason "canary fail"` then `routing pin runtime v2.4.1 --duration 45m` (or 60m if infra requests). I will post metric snapshots each step.

kevin: Communications plan: 23:10 PT staff brief (ops + leads), 23:20 PT internal brief, 23:30 deploy. Rachael will cut the internal blurb.

rachael: I'll cut the brief at 23:20 and include evacuation cue: "If rollback >15m we'll send targeted customer status." RN updated with changelog + runbook link.

ops-sam: Final check: thumbs on thresholds and pin durations?

kevin: Thumbs.

rachael: Thumbs.

infra-bot: Infra standing by. Will escalate to 60m pin if KV anomalies persist.

ops-sam: Kicking at 23:30 PT unless hold. Deploybot will update this thread. :rocket:
